correctness.rationale: The exact trace is a sum of closed walks on the N-by-N doubled torus. The minimum hop count bounds magnetic winding harmonics; transpose/swap similarity and gauge equivalence force odd-cycle half-flux periodicity. For the first permitted harmonic all factors are coherent hoppings, so rates cancel. Commutator binomial expansion gives both exact coefficients. Independent full-matrix implementation passes 432 comparisons; these are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: Exact physically motivated structural spectral invariant: magnetic holonomy is invisible to all short Liouvillian spectral moments, with a parity-dependent N versus 2N sharp threshold and exact nonvanishing binomial response. Robustness against arbitrary spatially heterogeneous pure-dephasing rates is a genuine structural statement. Not a mere table or numerical fit; spectral moment is an intrinsic finite-dimensional dynamical invariant with potential finite-moment spectroscopy use, without claiming experimental feasibility.
